title: Detectify launches Agentic Tooling to verify vulnerabilities in live applications
hint: Detectify has launched Agentic Tooling. It lets organizations’ own AI agents, running in their own environments, proactively investigate suspected vulnerabilities and test whether they can be exploited in running applications. A new Security Ledger lets security teams verify agents’ findings against objective evidence, ensuring informed decisions rather than relying solely on probabilistic conclusions. title: CVE-2026-130615: Flowise through 3.1.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to reach internal…
hint: Flowise through 3.1.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to reach internal services by exploiting unpinned DNS validation in checkDenyList(). Attackers can configure a chatflow with Playwright or Puppeteer loaders using a DNS-rebinding domain so headless Chromium fetches internal or cloud metadata endpoints, returning responses as document content. CVSS 7.6 HIGH. Published 2026-11-17.
